components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one gradient element: Search, beside the search field.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 46px; padding: 0 26px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0e7490, #2563eb); color: #fff; font: 600 15px system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / .12), 0 4px 10px -4px rgb(15 23 42 / .22); transition: filter .15s, transform .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #06b6d4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Load more: white pill with hairline and rest shadow.

components.name: Filter Chips

components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 12px 14px; background: #f1f5f9; border-radius: 14px; } .ds-chip { height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; background: #fff; color: #475569; font: 14px system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; transition: border-color .15s, color .15s, background .15s; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #cbd5e1; color: #0f172a; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #06b6d4; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #e0f6fb; border-color: #7dd3e8; color: #0e7490; font-weight: 500; } .ds-chip .n { font-size: 12px; color: #64748b; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] .n { color: #0e7490; }

components.name: Gallery Card
components.description: Masonry image card: flush image with a glass model tag, two-line title, muted meta with SVG heart.
components.css: .ds-card { display: block; width: 240px; padding: 0; border: 0; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; background: #fff; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / .05), 0 4px 12px -2px rgb(15 23 42 / .06); transition: box-shadow .2s, transform .2s; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgb(15 23 42 / .06), 0 14px 28px -8px rgb(15 23 42 / .16); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #06b6d4; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card-img { position: relative; } .ds-card-ph { height: 200px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #cbd5e1, #e9eef4); } .ds-card-tag { position: absolute; left: 10px; top: 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: #fff; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(15 23 42 / .55); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); } .ds-card-body { padding: 12px 14px 14px; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-weight: 650; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.4; color: #0f172a; } .ds-card-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; margin-top: 6px; color: #64748b; font-size: 12.5px; } .ds-card-meta .likes { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.css: .ds-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-tag { font-size: 12px; border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 9px; background: #f1f5f9; color: #475569; } .ds-tag.kind { background: #e0f6fb; color: #0e7490; font-weight: 500; } .ds-tag.new { background: #f1f5f9; color: #0f172a; font-weight: 600; } .ds-tag.pick { background: #fff; color: #0e7490; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #7dd3e8; font-weight: 600; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; } .ds-gain { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; margin-left: 8px; color: #475569; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Annotated Prompt Box
components.description: Signature component: toolbar with anatomy switch and Copy, mono prompt with role tints and underlines.
components.html: Editorial portrait of an elderly ceramicist shot on 85mm at f/1.8, soft window light from the left, warm earthy palette, Kinfolk magazine style, 4:5 vertical
components.css: .ds-prompt { width: 460px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; background: #fff; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-prompt-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 10px 8px 14px; background: #f1f5f9; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; font-size: 13px; color: #475569; } .ds-switch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch input { appearance: none; width: 30px; height: 18px; border-radius: 999px; background: #cbd5e1; position: relative; margin: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; } .ds-switch input::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .2); transition: transform .15s; } .ds-switch input:checked { background: #06b6d4; } .ds-switch input:checked::after { transform: translateX(12px); } .ds-link { border: 0; background: none; color: #0e7490; font-size: 13px; padding: 4px 6px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-link:hover { background: #e0f6fb; } .ds-link:focus-visible, .ds-switch input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #06b6d4; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-prompt-text { margin: 0; padding: 14px 16px; font: 13.5px/1.9 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, 'SF Mono', Menlo, ui-monospace, monospace; color: #0f172a; } .ds-prompt-text .seg { border-radius: 3px; padding: 1px 2px; -webkit-box-decoration-break: clone; box-decoration-break: clone; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 11%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) 70%, transparent); }

narrative.overview:
Workbench plays the prompt-gallery category straight, at full craft: a cool near-white page, white rounded cards that lift gently off it, slate ink, and pill-shaped everything a hand touches (search, chips, nav, tags, buttons). The image wall is the hero; chrome is quiet so pictures and prompts carry the colour. The one place the system departs from category habit is the prompt itself, which is never an undifferentiated text blob: every phrase can be coloured by its role (subject, style, light, camera, mood, format, parameters, negative).

Density is gallery-dense, not dashboard-dense. Cards sit 18px apart in a five-column masonry wall, filters live in one soft panel directly above it, and type stays in a single system sans so the interface reads as tool rather than brand. Mono type appears only where a prompt is being shown, which makes "this is a prompt" legible at a glance.
keyCharacteristics: Cool near-white canvas with white 12px cards on soft, low-contrast offset shadows.
Pill geometry for every interactive control.
One cyan accent family; a single cyan-to-blue gradient reserved for the primary button.
System sans throughout; mono only for prompt text.
Prompt-anatomy role colours are the only other hues in the system.

rules.name: The Anatomy-Only Rule
rules.body: Besides slate and cyan, colour exists only to label prompt roles. If a new surface needs a hue, it is a prompt role or it is cyan. The single sanctioned borrow is the Saved state of the Save button, which uses the mood rose for the filled heart.

rules.name: The One Gradient Rule
rules.body: The cyan-to-blue gradient (90deg, primary to gradient-end) appears on the primary Search button and nowhere else. One per view.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Prompt Rule
rules.body: Monospace marks prompt text and inline code, nothing else. Never set UI labels, numbers or headings in mono.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Headings stand alone. There are no small uppercase kicker labels above titles anywhere in the system.

rules.name: The Wrap-Then-Scroll Rule
rules.body: Filter chip rows wrap onto multiple lines on desktop so every option is visible; at 600px and below each row becomes a single sideways-scrolling line with the scrollbar hidden.

rules.name: The Soft-Lift Rule
rules.body: Clickable cards rise 2px and take the Lift shadow on hover (0.2s); nothing else moves on hover. Shadows are always soft and slate-tinted, never hard-edged or black.

dos: Do keep every pressable control a pill (999px) and every content container a 12 to 18px rounded rectangle.
Do show the active state of any filter or nav item as pale cyan fill, cyan hairline and cyan text.
Do keep Pick, kind and New tags visually distinct: hairline-and-star, cyan fill, and neutral panel respectively.
Do draw every icon, including hearts and stars, as an inline SVG at 1.8 stroke using currentColor.
Do use tabular figures for every count, rank, star, like and gain.
Do let chip rows wrap on desktop and scroll sideways at 600px and below.
Do keep text at 4.5:1 contrast or better against the surface it actually sits on, not just against white.
Do honour reduced motion: animations and transitions switch off entirely.
donts: Don't use the cyan-to-blue gradient on anything but the primary button.
Don't introduce hues outside slate, cyan and the prompt-anatomy roles.
Don't set anything but prompt text and inline code in mono.
Don't put eyebrow or kicker labels above headings.
Don't use text glyphs or emoji as icons (no typed hearts or stars).
Don't colour gain numbers; the cyan lives on the icon only.
Don't use hard, black, or zero-blur offset shadows; depth is soft and slate-tinted.
